caption:
The question we get most: where do the numbers come from? Answer: real public sources we will not name. Data platforms have strict rules about how their numbers can be reused, and we follow them. That costs us brand-name clout and a faster posting schedule. It buys an account that can defend every receipt it posts and still be here next festival season.

Slide 5 is our house rule. Hold us to it.

#BuildInPublic #OnlineSellingIndia #DataHonesty #EcommerceIndia #DigitalBazaar
